Build the LLM prompt from a summary

Source: R/llm.R
sd_build_prompt.Rd

Turns an sd_summary object (see sd_summarise()) into the full text prompt that sd_document() sends to the language model — instructions followed by the statistics themselves. Kept separate from sd_document() so the prompt can be inspected or unit-tested without needing Ollama (or any model) running.

Usage

sd_build_prompt(summary, instructions = NULL, language = "fi", context = NULL)

Arguments

summary

An sd_summary object, as returned by sd_summarise().

instructions

Character string with the instructions placed before the statistics. NULL (the default) uses a built-in instruction template (see language) asking for an overview, descriptions of the categorical/demographic and Likert-type variables, and a short data quality note.

language

Language of the built-in instructions template when instructions is left at its default NULL – one of "fi" (Finnish, the default), "en" (English) or "sv" (Swedish). Has no effect when instructions is supplied explicitly. This is independent of the language the survey data itself (variable labels etc.) happens to be in – a Finnish-language survey can still be documented in English, or vice versa. Note that format(summary) itself (the statistics block appended after instructions) is currently always formatted using Finnish labels regardless of language – see format.sd_summary().

context

Optional character string of retrieved background material to insert before the statistics block – typically the output of sd_retrieve_context(). NULL (the default) omits this section entirely, leaving the prompt exactly as before this parameter was added.

Value

A single character string: the full prompt.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
kooste <- sd_summarise(aineisto)
kehote <- sd_build_prompt(kooste)
cat(kehote)

# Englanninkieliset ohjeet samalle datalle:
kehote_en <- sd_build_prompt(kooste, language = "en")

# RAG-taustatiedolla:
store <- ragnar::ragnar_store_connect("oma_rag_store.ragnar.duckdb")
kehote_rag <- sd_build_prompt(kooste, context = sd_retrieve_context(kooste, store))
} # }
